_comment: Verified research data for the xauscalp case study. Every block has a source file inside the xauscalp repository. Values were transcribed from the reports on the date in asOf.

tests.method: pytest in a clean export of the private development repository, Python 3.12.10, no market data, no network; run 2026-11-16

study7.title: Opening-range breakout on broker history
study7.units: R per trade (R = the amount risked per trade)

criteria.text: At least 60% of folds and 3 of 5 years positive

donchian.postHocNote: Post-hoc diagnostic, run after the results were known. It does not change the verdict and was not used to choose anything.

parity.caveat: This shows calculation equivalence, not profitability. The trigger fired on 88 of the 90 sessions, so signal parity is not a selective test.

runs.text: 2 hard differences: an indicator window measured in wall-clock time
0 hard differences; 2 sessions missing (the tester excludes its end date)
Partial diagnostic run, not used as evidence

audits.title: The risk manager approved trades when spread, data age or free margin was NaN
One timezone offset applied to the whole history, an hour wrong for half the year
A 1,648-day data gap treated as consecutive bars
Walk-forward result concatenated trades that could overlap
A loader decoded files from the locked holdout period before trimming them
audits.status: fixed; readers stop at the research boundary, enforced by a static test

dryRun.source: docs/decisiones.md, ADR 37 (a documented result of the development repository; the order-sending component and its evidence files are not published)

limits: Drawdown lock at −8% from the peak
At most 3 trades per day and one position at a time; no martingale, grid or averaging
Volume always rounded down; invalid input means rejection
Demo accounts only; live trading disabled in code
hardCaps: Daily loss limit at most 3%, weekly at most 6%
At most 10 trades per day and one open position
limitations: Level-1 simulation on one-minute bars; the Strategy Tester was modelled from those bars, not from real ticks.
Broker history came from a demo feed with derived ask prices and optimistic spreads.
One instrument family over a short period, and no demo or live order trading.
Multi-asset research is designed and unit-tested on synthetic data; it was not run.
